metadata.title: My VybeKiit App
home.hero.title: Your app starts here.
home.hero.description: Tell your AI agent what you want to build. It wires the payments, the database, and the deploy. You just describe the idea.
home.features.payments.title: Payments built in
home.features.payments.body: Take money on day one with checkout wired in.
home.features.payments.tooltip: Your agent picks the checkout setup for you. You describe what you sell; they wire the buy button and test a practice purchase.
home.features.data.title: Your data, ready
home.features.data.body: A database and sign-in wired up without the setup headache.
home.features.data.tooltip: Accounts and saved info live in a database your agent manages. You never pick tables or run migrations yourself.
home.features.deploy.title: Live in minutes
home.features.deploy.body: Deploy to the web with a custom domain when you are ready.
home.features.deploy.tooltip: When you say go live, your agent ships the app and hooks up your domain. You stay in plain language the whole time.
home.features.stats.title: Visitor stats
home.features.stats.body: See who shows up and what they click. Ask your agent to turn on visitor stats.
home.features.stats.tooltip: PostHog is the visitor-stats layer behind this app. Ask your agent to see who uses my app and they turn it on, send a test visit, and explain the numbers in plain words.
home.features.alerts.title: Error alerts
home.features.alerts.body: Get a heads-up when something breaks. Ask your agent to wire error alerts.
home.features.alerts.tooltip: Sentry is the error-alert layer behind this app. Say tell me when things break and your agent connects it, sends a test alert, and pings you when real visitors hit a problem.

legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
legal.terms.sections.agreement.heading: 1. Agreement to terms
legal.terms.sections.agreement.body: By using {productName}, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
legal.terms.sections.using.heading: 2. Using the service
legal.terms.sections.using.body: You may use {productName} only as permitted by law and these terms. You are responsible for the activity in your account and for keeping your sign-in details secure.
legal.terms.sections.payments.heading: 3. Payments
legal.terms.sections.payments.body: Paid plans are billed in advance and are non-refundable except where required by law or stated otherwise. Prices may change with notice.
legal.terms.sections.liability.heading: 4. Liability
legal.terms.sections.liability.body: The service is provided "as is" without warranties. To the extent permitted by law, {companyName} is not liable for indirect or incidental damages arising from your use.
legal.terms.sections.contact.heading: 5. Contact
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.sections.collect.heading: 1. What we collect
legal.privacy.sections.collect.body: We collect the information you give us (such as your email when you sign up) and basic usage data needed to run {productName}.
legal.privacy.sections.use.heading: 2. How we use it
legal.privacy.sections.use.body: We use your information to provide the service, process payments, and keep your account secure. We do not sell your personal data.
legal.privacy.sections.sharing.heading: 3. Sharing
legal.privacy.sections.sharing.body: We share data only with the providers that run the service (for example, hosting, database, and payments) and only as needed to operate {productName}.
legal.privacy.sections.choices.heading: 4. Your choices
legal.privacy.sections.choices.body: You can ask us to access or delete your information at any time by contacting us.
